name: Entity Template UI
description: Admin interface for configuring Entity Template builders, blueprints, templates and components.
project_description: Entity Template UI is the configuration interface submodule of Entity Template. It attaches admin routes, forms and menu/action links for managing entity_template_builder and entity_template_blueprint config entities and for editing the templates, components and conditions inside a blueprint (via a shared-tempstore builder). It adds the _blueprint_storage_access route access check, a template-UI factory, an available-placeholders form element, and PluginForms for adding/configuring templates and components. Requires the base entity_template module.
